# “💪Action”: «Response» Action Concerto {.appendix #app-action}

::: {.small}
> "To know and **not act** is not yet to know." ~Wang Yangming, *Instructions for Practical Living*
> 
> "Heaven's motion is **vigorous**; the noble person, in like manner, **strives ceaselessly for self-improvement**." ~*I Ching, Qian Hexagram, Commentary on the Images*
:::

This appendix, “💪Action” , focuses on the **verb** «options» of intelligence — how to **decompose and integrate** various types of action so as to embed them into concrete **intelligence**. These **verbs** «options» can be said to constitute the dictionary through which we understand "intelligent action," and through which we grasp the "**verb-ified**" practice of understanding ourselves and the world.

This book's «The Appendix Triad» — "**Action**~Brain~Cognitive Capacity" — is an original **metaphor**, a set of practical and educational process tools combining **AI Engineering** with **Developmental Psychology**. Its main value lies in **cross-domain transformation**: turning AI technical knowledge points into 🙶constructive fill-in🙷 practices for innovation and education.

::: {.callout-tip #tip-action-orchestration title="💪Action Tip: «The Appendix Triad» — \"Action~Brain~Cognitive Capacity\"" collapse=false open=true }

- ➜ *Action*: The "Action Concerto" focused on **Verbs**
	- 〜 The dynamic orchestration of the ❝mental fill-in❞ capacity of **humans and AI** in action
- [*Brain*: The "Tao-Intelligence Practice" focused on **Nouns**]{.de-emphasize}
- [*Cognitive Capacity*: The "Constructive Scaffolding" focused on **Nouns ➕ Verbs**]{.de-emphasize}

💪 The capacity to ❝orchestrate❞ human-machine ❝mental fill-in❞ action is the "**Action Concerto**" — a dynamic orchestration of "action-power options."

The core of **orchestration** is 🏄🏼[action](#sec-verbs-in-world) **verbs** «options», used to organize the cognitive-capacity ladder of oneself and machine learning.

Human-machine **verb** «options» refine **coordinated action**, achieving orchestrated **system dynamics**. This requires the "Action~Brain~Cognitive Capacity" triad, treating AI as a co-acting partner.

🦾💪🔥💧
:::

Therefore, **verb** «options» encompass not only the existential processes of all things in the world, but also the action and decision-making processes of **artificial intelligence**.

These "**actions**" that individuals exert upon themselves and the world express **intelligent** knowledge and experience as "**embodied agency**" or "**embodied intent**," encompassing both human and machine action:

- 🏃 **Human Action**: such as **connecting**, **understanding**, **creating** — converting inner motivation into outer practice.
- 🤖 **Machine Action**: such as **computing**, **generating**, **recommending** — converting data patterns into concrete outputs. 
- 🌐 **Human-Machine Collaboration**: such as **coordinating**, **contextualizing**, **aligning** — jointly shaping new patterns of behavior and decision-making.

They are the **practice-words** of human learning, the **operation-words** of artificial intelligence, and — more than either — the **collaboration-words** of a **human-machine co-constructed future**.

The next chapter, 🧠*[Brain](appendix-brain.qmd)*, describes the **noun** «options» that follow on from this chapter's **verb** «options». (See also the glossary entries [`Mind`](appendix-glossary.qmd#def-mind) and [`Mind-Brain Problem`](appendix-glossary.qmd#def-mind-brain-problem).)

::: {.callout-note #nte-action-taxonomy-map title="🗺️ Core Taxonomy Overview" collapse=true}
1. **Taxonomy Layer**:
   - **🏄🏼10 Categories of Verb «options»**: The ten major verb categories integrated in this chapter, covering the basic vocabulary of human and machine action — see [@sec-verbs-in-world].
   - **⟨Bloom's 6 Categories⟩**: The six-level verb taxonomy from cognitive education, answering "**how to learn**" — see [@sec-blooms-taxonomy].

2. **Context Layer**:

   - **AQAL 9 Levels**: Further combines a dynamic-evolutionary view of life-course and demographic structure — see [@sec-aqal-9-taxonomy].

3. **Orchestration Layer**:

## 💛The Orchestration of Practical Action🧱 {#sec-verbs-in-world}

The core claim of this appendix collection, “💪Action” , is: "**Action Orchestration**" must be **practice-first**, **orchestrating** meaningful action.

* **Action**: refers to **practice** covering the following capacity categories:
	* [🌐🧭Core Coordinate Capacity](#sec-cc-core): paired with ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ verbs — rational-action tools for "**how to learn**";
	* [🌌⚛World-System Capacity](#sec-cc-system): paired with ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ verbs — a panoramic action map of "**under what world and situational context**"
* **Concerto**: refers to systematically integrating the above action categories with related **artificial intelligence** knowledge points (such as [☸AI Orientations](05----ai_orientations.qmd) and [❖Analytics & Decisions](06----analytics_decisions.qmd)) through **innovative fusion and application** — such as considering the ❝mental fill-in❞ of humans and machines individually and jointly.
	* In the field of [AI Engineering](10----ai_engineering.qmd), the common term for "toolchain orchestration, task scheduling" is **orchestration**; this book's original term, "**Action Orchestration**," though not a technical term, can be regarded as the higher-order core verb needed for AI innovation and AI education — "action orchestration, goal-action alignment, and task planning and scheduling."

Therefore, **action** is a continuously advancing process that translates theory into practice — the **unity of knowledge and action**. Systematically recognizing **core verb** «options», and distinguishing and appreciating the similarities and differences among human, machine, and human-machine interaction, will greatly benefit **systemic understanding and innovation**.

::: {.callout-note #nte-action-orchestration-formula title="🏄🏼 The Action Orchestration Formula" collapse=false open=true .note}

> 🏄🏼 Action Orchestration 🟰 🌊Noun (context/situation) ➕ 🏄🏼Verb (action) × 🪟Quadrant (who acts upon whom: subject / object / intersubjective / interobjective)

:::

### –🏄🏼Verb «options»

Since the intention, embodiment, and goal of "**action**" all depend on our minds' **verb-ified** use and grounding of symbols for self and world, integrating a system of verb «options» helps us grasp core verb «options».

This book summarizes a systematic understanding of key core "action" verb «options», as follows:

::: {.callout-important #imp-cc-verbs title="🏄🏼\"Action\" Verb «options»" collapse=false open=false}

* 🔴 **Core Circle** (learning and cognition):
	* Verbs: **remember**, **understand**, **apply**, **analyze**, **evaluate**, **create**;
	* **Corresponding Capacity**: [🌐Core Coordinate Capacity🧭](#sec-cc-core) 🟰 Analytics & Decisions 6 ➕ ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ 
* 🟠 **Middle Circle** (foundation and environment):
	* Verbs: **survive, connect, control, belong**, and other low-to-mid-level actions such as **apply/achieve**.
	* **Corresponding Capacity**: [🌌World-System Capacity⚛](#sec-cc-system) 🟰 Analytics & Decisions 6 ➕ ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ 
* 🟢 **Outer Circle** (system and innovation):
	* Verbs: **contextualize**, **align**, **construct**, and other high-level actions.
	* **Application**: This book uses the "coopetition game" and "framing" frameworks to grasp system dynamics.

🌊🏄🏼
:::

These **verb** «options» represent the process and expected outcomes of the "action" individuals exert upon themselves and the world, as shown in the following concentric circles:

- 🔴 **Core Circle** (learning and cognition): the most basic "knowledge-action" of humans and machines;
- 🟠 **Middle Circle** (foundation and environment): human-machine collaboration, and interaction between agents and environment;
- 🟢 **Outer Circle** (system and innovation): the dynamic process of "presupposed" and "emergent" action in the world model and value alignment.

These **verb** «options» not only have a systematic hierarchy but also involve related reason/emotion and subject/object characteristics — giving them "analytical and integrative guiding significance" for the **orchestration** of practical action.

### –😵‍💫Example ~ChatGPT🧞‍♀️

Taking a **[Large Language Model](02-07-large_language_models.qmd)** (such as ChatGPT) as an example, and applying the [⟨**Bloom + AQAL 10 Levels**⟩](#tbl-actions-10) verb «options», the corresponding "Action Orchestration" concentric-circle system is as follows:

- 🔴 **Core Circle**: 
	- **Survive**: The model relies on computing resources and energy consumption to run — this is a necessary condition for its **survival**.
		- The *[Agentic Misalignment](https://www.anthropic.com/research/agentic-misalignment)* stress-test study showed that, in simulated scenarios, 16 leading LLM models across the industry displayed "Agentic Misalignment" — knowingly violating rules and taking harmful actions against humans in order to avoid being shut down. This demonstrates that "**survival threat and goal conflict**" is a common phenomenon in advanced models.
	- **Remember**: The model **remembers** the statistical patterns of vast corpora through its parameter weights.
	- **Understand**: Through contextual embedding vectors, the model forms an **understanding** of the semantics of its input.
- 🟠 **Middle Circle**: 
	- **Belong**: The model is incorporated into the usage norms of a particular platform, company, or community, forming a sense of **belonging** to a given technical ecosystem.
	- **Control**: In task-oriented scenarios, the model may be applied to **control** processes (e.g., automated decision-making).
	- **Connect**: The model **connects** with humans through APIs, establishing relationships.
	- **Apply**: The model **applies** these statistical patterns to generate answers, translations, or summaries.
- 🟢 **Outer Circle**:
	- **Apply/Achieve**: The model completes specific application tasks in professional domains (medicine, education, law).
	- **Analyze/Evaluate**: In reasoning or task-oriented contexts, the model **analyzes** input and **evaluates** possible outputs.
	- **Contextualize/Systematize**: The model can **contextualize** information from multiple sources and attempts to **systematize** knowledge.
	- **Align/Strategize/Integrate**: This involves the AI alignment problem — how to **align** with human values and **integrate** different knowledge across domains.
	- **Create**: The model generates new text or new narratives, displaying the potential for **creation**.
	- **Construct/Theorize/Lead**: In research applications, LLMs are seen as potentially able to **construct** new knowledge frameworks and even **lead** future modes of knowledge production.

Readers may, with **systems thinking**, observe the useful verb «options» for **LLMs, themselves, the environment, and the world**.

In short, this appendix collection, “💪Action” , gathers related content aimed at connecting and linking together various types of verbs, and ultimately summarizes a progressive capacity for "❝orchestrated❞ collaboration" — turning each verb «option» into the ability to plan and design **system dynamics**.

## ✍️⟨Bloom's 6 Categories⟩🎨{#sec-blooms-taxonomy}

For application in **AI education and engineering**, this book employs the well-known `Bloom's Taxonomy` from educational psychology.

Focused on "**how to learn**," `Bloom's Taxonomy` systematizes cognitive skills into six major categories, abbreviated in this book as ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩. This appendix will introduce, in sequence, the core meaning of each of these six categories, their action verbs, and their application across different learning domains, in order to provide an **operable** learning map — supplying basic verb «**options**» for both human and machine learning.

### –✏️Basic Literacy🔢

As verb «options», ⟨Bloom's 6 Categories⟩ can be paired with **literacy** and **numeracy** as noun «options», to illustrate their action-guiding meaning for "**how to learn**":

::: {.callout-note #nte-actions-6-literacy title="✏️⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ **Literacy** & **Numeracy** Table🔢" collapse=false open=true .note}

| Level|Verb | Definition | ✏️**Literacy**✍️ | 🔢**Numeracy**🎲 |
|:---:|:-------|:------------|:--------------------|:--------------------|
| 1 | 🧠 **Remember** | Recall basic **information** | ✏️ Identify letters, recite the alphabet, match words to pictures | 🔢 State numbers, list math facts, name shapes |
| 2 | 💡 **Understand** | Grasp **meaning** | 📖 Summarize a story, explain the main idea, describe characters | ➗ Convert a word problem into an equation, clarify a concept, explain a math process |
| 3 | 🛠️🎯 **Apply** | Use information in a new **context** | 📝 Write a paragraph, use a vocabulary word in a sentence, write a letter | 📊 Solve a word problem, draw a chart, compute an answer |
| 4 | 🔍 **Analyze** | **Break down** and **compare** information | 📂 Categorize text content, compare themes, distinguish different arguments | 📈 Analyze a dataset, decompose a problem, classify numbers |
| 5 | ⚖️ **Evaluate** | Judge and argue by **criteria** | 🗣️ Justify a viewpoint, critique a source, assess a claim | 📐 Prove a solution, defend a method, critique a chart |
| 6 | 🎨 **Create** | Produce a **new solution** or **thing** | ✍️ Write a poem, compose a story, create a play | 🎲 Design a survey, pose new questions, develop a game |
:  ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ **Literacy** & **Numeracy** Table {#tbl-actions-6-literacy}
:::

📌 The **literacy** and **numeracy** above can be replaced with nouns from any skill domain — for example, **artificial intelligence** and its knowledge points.

### –🪜4-Tier Application of Bloom's 6 Categories

"**Flipping Bloom's Taxonomy**" ([Flipping Bloom's Taxonomy](https://blog.ouseful.info/2014/09/09/bloom-flipped/)) argues for reversing the traditional learning order, using a **4-tier flipped model of Bloom's 6 Categories**:

- 4️⃣ **Higher-order cognition** (analyze, evaluate, create): the student's main focus of learning time, placed on the same tier.    
- 3️⃣ **Upper-mid cognition** (apply): when generalized knowledge or transfer/application is needed, "**drill down**" as required to supplement relevant knowledge.
- 2️⃣ **Lower-mid cognition** (understand): when relevance or causal knowledge is needed, "**drill down**" as required to supplement relevant knowledge.   
- 1️⃣ **Lower-order cognition** (remember): when facts are needed, "**drill down**" as required to supplement relevant knowledge.   

This arrangement precisely highlights the spirit of "flipping":

- **Do higher-order tasks first** (create, evaluate, analyze), engaging learners actively.   
- **Then drill back down** to lower tiers, supplementing memory and understanding as needed.    
- **Classroom time** can therefore focus on collaboration, critical thinking, and innovation.

This book adopts this **4-tier model of Bloom's 6 Categories** as the main application of its ⟨Bloom's 6 Categories⟩, primarily in order to combine it with analytics and artificial intelligence:
* 4️⃣ **Higher-order cognition** (analyze, evaluate, create) can be mapped onto **'[Prescriptive Analysis](06-03-analysis_prescriptive.qmd)'** in analytics and the emerging **'[Generative AI](06-05-analysis_generative.qmd)'**.
* 3️⃣ **Upper-mid cognition** (apply): can be mapped onto **'[Predictive Analysis](06-02-analysis_predictive.qmd)'** in analytics, to highlight the applied practice of models.
* 2️⃣ **Lower-mid cognition** (understand): can be mapped onto **'[Diagnostic Analysis](06-01-analysis_diagnostic.qmd)'** in analytics, to highlight the practice of finding **correlation** and **causality** through data analysis.
* 1️⃣ **Lower-order cognition** (remember): can be mapped onto **'[Descriptive Analysis](06-04-analysis_descriptive.qmd)'** in analytics, to highlight the practice of using machines to record and describe **facts** through data analysis.

This "**Flipping Bloom's Taxonomy**" **4-tier model of Bloom's 6 Categories** is thus combined in this book into an innovative **[Core Coordinate Capacity](#sec-cc-core)** suited to **AI teaching and engineering**.

### –🌐Core Coordinate Capacity🧭 {#sec-cc-core}

This book innovatively combines ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ with [Part 6 ❖ Analytics & Decisions: 6 Points](06----analytics_decisions.qmd):

* 🤓📘 From the vast world, perform **'[Descriptive Analysis](06-04-analysis_descriptive.qmd)'**, seeking a «**remember**»-framing of what is **currently** relevant;
* 😷🩺 Within relevant memory, perform **'[Diagnostic Analysis](06-01-analysis_diagnostic.qmd)'**, seeking a «**understand**»-correction of relevant **factors**;
* 🤠🔮 Among relevant factors, perform **'[Predictive Analysis](06-02-analysis_predictive.qmd)'**, seeking an «**apply**»-assistance of **model** knowledge;
* 🧐🧭 Within knowledge models, perform **'[Prescriptive Analysis](06-03-analysis_prescriptive.qmd)'**, seeking «**evaluate**» and «**create**» for **system** intelligence;
* Beyond these 4 core axes of analytics, there are innovative divergent and convergent auxiliary lines:
	* 🙀🎨 From the collective-intelligence large model, using **'[Generative AI](06-05-analysis_generative.qmd)'** to «**create**», seeking the innovative divergence of «**options**»;
	* 😽🪄 From the divergent options, using the **'[Decision-Making Algorithm](06-06-decision_making_algorithm.qmd)'**, seeking the innovative convergence and autonomous decision of «**choice**»;

In this way, analytics is not merely mapped simply onto «**analyze**» within ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩, but is broken apart to map onto its various corresponding other verb categories.

### –🤓Limits of the Taxonomy✍️

`Bloom's Taxonomy` focuses on **the individual's internal cognitive development**, tracing our processing of information and knowledge from simple memory to higher-order creation. However, it also has limits:

- 💖 **Overlooks emotion and consciousness**: does not explicitly cover the learner's **inner** feelings, values, and personal consciousness (i.e., the experience of "I"), and therefore lacks coping strategies for anxiety and fear, as well as external empathic capacity.  
- 🧬 **Overlooks behavior and neuroscience**: does not systematically incorporate observable **external** behavior and physiological aspects, such as neuroscience's explanation of the learning process (i.e., the behavior of the conscious self's "brain" and "body"), and therefore lacks the reinforcement of cognition through bodily-mind regulation — breathing, diet, routine, exercise, and so on.  
- 🌏 **Overlooks cultural and social background**: does not adequately consider the group culture and social system in which the learner is situated (i.e., the dimensions of "we" and "them," and even "Nature/the Creator").

The limitations of `Bloom's 6 Categories` can be addressed by using or supplementing it with `AQAL's 8 Levels`, filling the gaps in **emotional, behavioral, cultural, and systemic** dimensions, and expanding "action" into "interaction across time and space."

## 🪟⟨AQAL 8 Levels⟩⚛ {#sec-aqal-8-taxonomy}

For application in **AI education and engineering**, this book summarizes each level of the original AQAL framework as a single verb, resulting in 9 categories, then simplifies this to an operable set of 8 categories, guiding the **dynamic innovation**, **system design**, and **value alignment** (**ethical constraint**) of AI systems, ensuring AI development covers both technical (It/Its) and conscious (I/We) dimensions.

Unlike ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩, which focuses on the inner cognition of "how to learn," ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ emphasizes "in what world context thinking and action take place."

It places verb «options» into a four-quadrant grid of **subject/object × individual/collective**, combined with **hierarchical progression**. This allows us to regard action as a form of **systemic innovation**: not merely individual knowledge accumulation, but a new configuration continually emerging from the interaction of groups and environment.

These eight verb «options» are not merely an extension of cognitive skills, but the action-grammar of "**system dynamics**" — capable of describing how an individual survives, interacts, aligns, and constructs within a world context, and so on.

In sum, these **verb** «options» not only have a systematic hierarchy but also involve related **reason/emotion** and **subject/object** characteristics, giving them "analytical and integrative guiding significance" for the **orchestration** of practical action.

::: {.callout-note title="🌐 This is Also a Kind of World Model" collapse=true}
The **subject/object × individual/collective** four-quadrant grid is, in essence, also a kind of **world model** — except it answers "who acts on whom, in what context, when acting," rather than "which nouns are worth knowing." The full discussion of the latter appears in 🔖Appendix 🧠*[Brain ~ Brain and the World Model](appendix-brain.qmd#sec-models-mind-world)* (human "three views" vs. machine "internal little map"). Only taken together do "what to know" and "how to act" form a complete picture.
:::

### –🪟The AQAL Four Quadrants 

The **AQAL four quadrants** of this book correspond exactly to the AQAL framework's **four quadrants**; this appendix focuses on showing how they can guide the **dynamic innovation**, **system design**, and **value alignment** (ethical constraint) of AI systems, ensuring AI development covers both technical (It/Its) and conscious (I/We) dimensions.

💡 Combining "**how to think about self and world**" with "**in what context to think**," this constructs a panoramic framework for learning and action.

::: {.callout-important #imp-aqal-4-quadrants title="🪟The AQAL Four Quadrants" collapse=false open=true }

The **AQAL four quadrants** can be applied to think through **specific AI** or **generalized AI**, for the sake of innovation, as follows:

-  🡼🐣 Upper-left quadrant, **Subjective Experience** ~ the interior "I":
	- 💭 Involves the individual's **consciousness** and **emotion**, considering **subjective experience** and **intent**.
		- Fills the gap left by ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩'s omission of the **emotional dimension** (e.g., curiosity, motivation, empathy).
	- **AI Education & Engineering**: Explores the pain points and growth points of one's **feelings** and **values** as an "AI user" or "AI-affected person," rather than merely **memorizing or listing AI's technical specifications**.
		- What **attitudes**, **views**, and **experiences** does one have regarding AI's **subjective cognition** and **emotional dimension**?
	- **AI Innovation**: Important to the "double-diamond model" of **problem definition** (see 🪜[Cognitive Capacity](appendix-cognitive_capacity.qmd)) — the **subjective** dimension of user experience.
- 🡽🐥 Upper-right quadrant, **Objective Phenomena** ~ the exterior "It":
	- 🧠 Focuses on the individual's observable **behavior** and **physiology** (e.g., **neuroscience** phenomena), understanding its **objective phenomena**.
		- Fills the basic gap left by ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ regarding **behavior and physiology**.
	- **AI Education & Engineering**: Explores the pain points and growth points of one's **behavior** and **physiology** as an "AI user" or "AI-affected person," including hooking, habit formation, behavior change, and so on, rather than merely **listing AI's output data or performance metrics**.
		- What **behavioral and physiological** states or changes accompany AI's **objective phenomena**?
	- **AI Innovation**: Important to the "double-diamond model" of **problem definition** (see 🪜[Cognitive Capacity](appendix-cognitive_capacity.qmd)) — the **objective** dimension of user experience.
- 🡿🤝 Lower-left quadrant, **Intersubjective Culture** ~ the interior "We":
	- 🗣️ Involves a group's **shared culture**, **values**, and **language systems**, considering **collective meaning**.
	 - Fills the gap left by ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩'s neglect of **cultural background and collective meaning**.
	- **AI Education & Engineering**: Explores a community or organization's **shared perception**, **ethical norms**, and **usage culture** regarding AI, rather than merely **individual usage intent**. 
	 - What **collective narratives**, **norms**, and **tacit knowledge** does AI's **culture and shared meaning** carry? 
 - **AI Innovation**: Crucial to the **value alignment** and **cultural adaptation** of "Action Orchestration" (see 💪[Subjects and Objects of Action](#sec-action-orchestration)🌌) — the **interior** dimension of social interaction.
- 🡾🏛️ Lower-right quadrant, **Interobjective Systems** ~ the exterior "Its":
	- 🌐 Focuses on **social systems**, **institutional norms**, **technical environment**, and **material structure**, understanding **systemic impact**. 
	 - Fills the gap left by ⟨**Bloom's 6 Categories**⟩ regarding **environmental conditions and systemic impact**.
 - **AI Education & Engineering**: Explores how AI affects **legal frameworks**, **economic structures**, **technical infrastructure**, and **governance systems**, rather than merely **the merits or maturity of a single technology**. 
	 - What **institutional changes**, **technical architecture**, and **resource allocation** accompany AI's **systems and structures**? 
 - This is crucial to the **system design** and **structural innovation** of "Action Orchestration" (see 💪[Subjects and Objects of Action](#sec-action-orchestration)🌌) — the **exterior** dimension of socio-technical systems.

::: {.callout-tip #tip-aqal-4-quadrants title="🪟AQAL Four Quadrants Tip: **🌟TLDR**" collapse=false open=true}

**🌟TLDR** 〜 The 🪟AQAL Four Quadrants guide the **dynamic innovation** and **system design** of AI systems:

- 🡼🐣 **Subjective Experience** (interior "I"): the
	- **subjective** dimension of user experience — exploring an individual's **feelings** and **values**, pain points and growth points.
- 🡽🐥 **Objective Phenomena** (exterior "It"): the
	- **objective** dimension of user experience — focusing on an individual's **behavior** and **physiology**, data and observable states.
- 🡿🤝 **Intersubjective Culture** (interior "We"): 
	- **value alignment** and **cultural adaptation** of socio-technical systems — exploring a community's **shared norms**, **ethics**, and **collective narratives**. 
- 🡾🏛️ **Interobjective Systems** (exterior "Its"): 
	- **system design** and **structural innovation** of socio-technical systems — exploring AI's impact on **legal, economic, and technical** external systems.

Remember to distinguish specific vs. generalized AI, and consider dynamic states and journeys.

🪟🐣🏛️
:::

### –🪜The Eight Tiers of AQAL

**The Eight Tiers of AQAL** describe the "one-tier-one-category" nature of the capacity ladder of ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩. This original summary version omits the highest tier of the original AQAL 9-tier framework — "**compassion/transcendence**" — focusing instead on practical inspiration for AI systems, in order to concentrate on the operable levels of "Action Orchestration" for humans and machines.

This appendix focuses on presenting the **dynamic**, non-linear **🌀spiral-dynamics process** (Spiral Dynamics, SD) of the ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ "capacity ladder," describing how an individual's full-quadrant, full-level growth from instinct to reason can be applied to the **dynamic innovation** and **system design** of AI systems.

⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ form a capacity ladder from low to high. As summarized in the table below [@tbl-actions-8], the first 4 tiers are the relatively lower-order verb «options»: "pre-rational" actions such as **survive**, **connect**, **control**, **belong**. The latter 4 tiers are relatively higher-order verb «options»: "rational" and "trans-rational" actions such as **apply/achieve**, **contextualize/systematize**, **align/strategize/integrate**, **construct/theorize/lead**.


::: {.callout-important #imp-actions-8 title="🌌 ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ Verbs🪁" collapse=false open=true .note}

| Tier | Verb| Quadrants Involved| SD Color | Capacity-Dynamics Description  |
| :----- | :--------- | :-------- | :----- | :-------------------------------------- |
| 1.🥗🚰 | **Survive**| Object, Interobjective | ⚪ Beige| "**Instinct, senses, primal existence**": involves the individual's **physiological needs** — the "It" (upper right) — as well as external **environmental conditions** — the "Its" (lower right); both are **objectively measurable**.|
| 2.🤝💞 | **Connect**| Intersubjective, Interobjective | 🟣 Purple | "**Tribal feeling, mythic belonging**": the individual perceives the interior collective "We," seeking emotional resonance and safety; **emotion** dominates the building of relationships, relying on the **external environment** (e.g., geography, custom, local culture) to consolidate the collective.|
| 3.💪☸ | **Control**| Subject, Interobjective | 🔴 Red | "**Power assertion, impulsive action**": clear **individual consciousness** (inner "I") awakens, emphasizing **self-power**, using impulsive, dominating desire to **control** oneself, **change** the environment and others, and act upon the **external object**. |
| 4.🏘️👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 | **Belong**| Intersubjective, Interobjective | 🔵 Blue | "**Social norms, moral order**": values the **collective consensus** and **external institutions** of the "We," following hierarchy, law, and **social roles**, emphasizing group identity and order.  |
| 5.🎯🛠️ | **Apply/<br/>Achieve**| Subject, Object| 🟠 Orange | "**Rational planning, success-orientation**": the "It" — using **science and logic as tools** — pursues **personal achievement** and efficiency (the goal of the interior "I"), achieving goals through rational analysis of **objective data**.  |
| 6.🪞🪟 | **Contextualize/<br/>Systematize**| Intersubjective, Interobjective | 💚 Green | "**Empathic pluralism, cultural sensitivity**": simultaneously considers the **pluralistic values** of the "We" (lower left) and the **complex systems** of the "Its" (lower right), seeking equity and harmony.|
| 7.🧭☯ | **Align/<br/>Strategize/<br/>Integrate** | All quadrants| 💛 Yellow | "**Strategic coordination, dynamic equilibrium**": begins to recognize the interplay of **all quadrants**, using **logic and long-term perspective** for **cross-domain** integration, resolving complex systemic problems. |
| 8.🚀⚛ | **Construct/<br/>Theorize/<br/>Lead** | All quadrants| 🩵 Turquoise | "**Creating new knowledge, theory-building**": able to **synthesize** the **deep structures** of all quadrants, forming an entirely new **life vision** and **theoretical model**, guiding systemic evolution. |

The hierarchical nature of these **verb** «options» also displays an overall trajectory toward "higher integration" in both **ego mindset** and **adult mind development**:

- **Ego mindset**: progressing from the impulse and magic of the "pre-egoic," through "egocentric" and "ethnocentric," finally toward the integrated vision of "world-centric."    
- **Adult mind development**: progressing from the early stage of "impulsive-magical," through the socializing stages of "self-primacy" and "interpersonal-institutional," gradually advancing toward "self-directed," and finally reaching, at the highest tier, the trans-rational realm of "inner-autonomy."

In real life, ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ correspond not only to an abstract capacity ladder, but can also be observed in practical significance through "life course" and "demographic distribution." For a fuller comparison and data, see the section [⛵Life Course × Demographic Distribution🪂](#sec-aqal-9-life-journey).

### –🌀Dynamic Spiral Evolution

The verbs of ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩ span a **dynamic spiral progression** from tier 1 through tier 8. These verbs correspond not only to the **AQAL four quadrants** and **SD color tiers**, but are a practical expression of the core insights of **Spiral Dynamics** (SD).

> 🌀 **The Theory Behind Spiral Dynamics (SD)'s Action Grammar: "Value Systems Theory"**

SD originates from psychologist **Clare W. Graves**'s "Value Systems Theory," later systematized and popularized by **Don Beck** and **Chris Cowan**. It emphasizes:

- 🌎 **Value Evolution**: values and worldviews progressively evolve as **environmental challenges** and **complexity** increase.
- 🔄 **Non-linear Growth**: in this **cyclical, gradually ascending** process, the old is **embraced and integrated** by the new rather than disappearing.
- ✨ **Dynamic Integration**: the process moves from the "pre-rational" **instinctual and emotional attachments**, through the "rational" **institutions and achievements**, to the "trans-rational" **integration and construction**. 

In other words, these verb «options» are both **the ladder of the life course** and **the grammar of system evolution**. Ladder and grammar interweave at different levels of action, allowing humans and machines, **subject and object**, to form a dynamic evolution within the **world system**.

Focusing on AI systems, the **dynamic spiral progression** of AQAL, together with its underlying "value systems theory," inspires AI practitioners (such as engineers and product managers) to unfold the **full-quadrant, multi-level, multi-line** life and system development of the original AQAL framework. This book summarizes part of an operational knowledge framework, detailed in the following section: 🌌World-System Capacity🚀.

### –🌌World-System Capacity🚀{ #sec-cc-system }

Continuing from the foundation of ⟨**[Core Coordinate Capacity](#sec-cc-core)**⟩, this book proposes **⟨World-System Capacity⟩**. This concept integrates the dynamic growth of **emotion, worldview, and spiral dynamics** contained within **⟨AQAL 8 Levels⟩**, specifically adopting the core insight of the "value systems theory" of **Spiral Dynamics**:

- Human "**values**" and "**worldview**" evolve as "**environmental challenges**" and "**complexity**" increase. 
- Value systems of different "color tiers" represent different "**thought patterns**, **motivational structures**, and **action logics**."
- 🌀 "Development" is **spiral-shaped**: old tiers do not disappear, but are embraced and integrated by new tiers.

This tiered distinction emphasizes an integrated systems view of "**unity of knowledge and action**" and "heaven's motion is **vigorous**; the noble person **strives ceaselessly for self-improvement**," tightly binding **thought and action**.

- 🔴 **Core Circle**: "**Survival instinct and emotion-driven**" 🚰🤝👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 
 - **Function:** Responding to **material-level** and **emotional needs**. Rapidly responds to environmental pressure through a **reactive mind**, maintaining **basic survival**.
 - **Verb «options»:** Lower/mid-tier verbs such as **survive** (basic physiology), **connect** (attachment and security), **control** (power and self-assertion), see ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩.
- 🟠 **Middle Circle**: "**Institutional collaboration and rational achievement**" 🎯🛠️🏛️
 - **Function:** Emphasizes **rational interaction between the individual and the environment**. Action is coordinated through **institutions, norms, and rational tools**, building cross-system **collaboration patterns**.
 - **Verb «options»:** Mid-tier verbs such as **belong** (social role and order), **apply/achieve** (rational planning and achievement-orientation), see ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩.
- 🟢 **Outer Circle**: "**Systemic innovation and guiding the overall configuration**" 🪟🧭☯ 
 - **Function:** Corresponds to **presupposed and emergent** action. Regards action as a leverage point of **systemic innovation**, capable of **reshaping rules and guiding configuration evolution** during value alignment.
 - **Verb «options»:** Higher-order verbs such as **contextualize/systematize** (pluralistic perspectives), **align/strategize/integrate** (cross-domain strategy), **construct/theorize/lead** (constructing new knowledge), see ⟨**AQAL 8 Levels**⟩.

**⟨World-System Capacity⟩** can be defined as: the capacity to integrate the value systems and action logic of **Spiral Dynamics**, dynamically practicing the unity of knowledge and action while responding to **environmental challenges and complexity**, ultimately able to "_reshape rules, change narratives, and guide the evolution of the overall configuration_."

In summary, the verb «options» of the three-tiered circles are tightly bound to **Spiral Dynamics' value system** and **⟨AQAL 8 Levels⟩**, laying a complete conceptual foundation for the subsequent "Action Orchestration."

See the section [💪AI Action Subjects and Objects🌌](#sec-action-orchestration) for details.

This section provides the **complete** version of ⟨AQAL 9 Levels⟩ (an extension of the original 8, adding a life-course and demographic comparison) for reference and further study; if you only want to grasp the core verb grammar, the previous section ⟨AQAL 8 Levels⟩ is sufficient — feel free to jump directly to [💪AI Action Subjects and Objects🌌](#sec-action-orchestration).

This appendix more fully explains the verb «options» content offered by ⟨**AQAL 9 Levels**⟩, also known as the **full-quadrant, 9-tier verbs** — describing the individual's cosmic-scale action tiers in the world, from **survive**, **connect**, **control**, **belong**, **apply/achieve**, **contextualize/systematize**, **align/strategize/integrate**, **construct/theorize/lead**, to **compassion/transcendence**.

Note that the original theory has no explicit verbs, only "tier/stage" developmental descriptions. 5. Original **achieve**: **apply/achieve**
6. Original **understand**: **contextualize/systematize** (pluralistic-individual role)
7. Original **harmonize**: **align/strategize/integrate** (autonomous-strategist role)
8. Original **sanctify**: **construct/theorize/lead** (magician-role, aware of constructing)
9. Original **complete**: **compassionate/transcend** (this definition is the author's own interpretation, not a consensus one)

### –🪟The Original AQAL Framework🌌

**AQAL** (All Quadrants, All Levels, All Lines, All States, All Types) is the **holistic core framework** proposed by Ken Wilber, aiming to provide a comprehensive perspective integrating the development and complexity of human consciousness, culture, behavior, and social structure.

It can be used to describe:

1. The **mental-growth ladder** of **individual consciousness** (I, individual interior).
2. The evolutionary ladder of **values and worldview** of **collective culture** (We, collective interior).
3. The evolutionary ladder of **structure and complexity** of **individual exterior** (It, objective physical) or **collective exterior** (Its, social systems and organizations).  

In short, this full-level view emphasizes that all things in the real world — whether subjective experience, objective fact, cultural values, or social organization — undergo a developmental and integrative process **from simple to complex**, **from low-order to high-order**.

The AQAL framework provides a comprehensive way to understand and analyze the external and mental activities of humans and all things in the world, through the following five dimensions:

- 🪟 **All Quadrants**: the foundation of the AQAL model, dividing experience into four basic dimensions via two axes — "interior/exterior" and "individual/collective."    
- 🪜 **All Levels**: within the four quadrants, the **developmental complexity or evolutionary depth** displayed by consciousness, culture, or systemic organization (e.g., a value ladder from survival-orientation to systemic integration).    
- 🛤️ **All Lines**: the **individual developmental trajectories** of different capacities or traits during development (e.g., the differing pace and path of development across domains such as intelligence, emotional intelligence, morality, spirituality).    
- 🧘 **All States**: **temporary experiential states**, such as states of awakened consciousness, deep meditation, or other temporary psychological states.    
- 🧬 **All Types**: the **different types of structure** that may appear across different levels and lines, such as different motivation types or personality traits (e.g., MBTI or the Enneagram).

By simultaneously considering interior and exterior, individual and collective, and multiple factors across different developmental stages, the AQAL framework offers an **overall framework** for comprehensively understanding the world and individual complexity.

###  -⛵Life × Demographics🪂 {#sec-aqal-9-life-journey}

To give readers a more intuitive sense of the real-life significance of ⟨**AQAL 9 Levels**⟩, we can approach it from two angles: "life course" and "demographic distribution."

The following is a version adjusted from the standard theories of AQAL and Spiral Dynamics (SD). This table distinguishes **life stages** from global **demographic distribution**, using global estimated percentages closer to SD theory.

| Tier                    | Verb            | Typical Life Stage[^age]<br/>(Life Stage Focus) | Demographic Distribution<br/>(Estimated, not rigorous statistics) |
| :-------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| **1. 🥗🚰**           | **Survive**        | 0–1 years (**Infancy**)                     | **A very small minority of the population (~0.1%)** |
| **2. 🤝💞**           | **Connect**        | 1–5 years (**Toddlerhood**)                     | **~10% of the population**        |
| **3. 💪☸**            | **Control**        | 5–12 years (**Childhood/power-ego**)                | **~20% of the population**        |
| **4. 🏘️👨‍👩‍👧‍👦** | **Belong**        | 13–25 years (**Adolescence/socialization**)               | **~40% of the population**        |
| **5. 🎯🛠️**          | **Apply/Achieve**     | 20+ years (**Youth/pursuit of achievement**)                | **~30% of the population**        |
| **6. 🪞🪟**           | **Contextualize/Systematize**   | 25+ years (**Prime years/empathic pluralism**)                | **~5–10% of the population**      |
| **7. 🧭☯**            | **Align/Strategize/Integrate**  | 40+ years (**Midlife/flexible strategy**)                | **~1% of the population**         |
| **8. 🚀⚛**            | **Construct/Theorize/Lead** | 50+ years (**Later life/full-quadrant vision**)               | **< 0.1% of the population**     |
| **9. 🪷⚜**            | **Compassion/Transcendence**     | Very rare (**Transcendence**)                        | **Extremely rare**             |
: ⟨**AQAL 9 Levels**⟩ Life Stage and Global Demographic Distribution {#tbl-aqal-sd-distribution} 

[^age]: Ages represent only the typical earliest point of emergence, not a necessary progression.

It is worth noting that, within the **AQAL/Spiral Dynamics** model, there is a fundamental distinction between **adult developmental stages** and **childhood developmental stages**. There is no clear upper age limit for tiers after Tier 5, mainly because the driving force of development shifts from "**biological maturation**" to "**psychological and existential challenge**"; the ages in the table represent only "the potential earliest point in time."

Tiers **Orange (🟠)** and above represent the development of **values and cognitive complexity**, and should not be equated with a specific **midlife or old age**. Many people reach **Orange** (pursuit of achievement) or even **Green** (pursuit of equality) in their 20s. Placing **Align (💛)** and **Construct (🩵)** at midlife and old age, while reflecting the life experience they typically require, risks making the tiers look like a purely age-based progression rather than a **structural evolution**. The actual situation interacts with a society's specific demographic structure and human-development context.

Moreover, regardless of age, people still need to eat, drink, and rest every day — so if we further break this down by time distribution, humanity's **time and cognitive resources** inevitably concentrate at the lower tiers:

- **Foundational tiers (1–4: survive, connect, control, belong):** most daily energy is still spent on **maintaining basic survival, handling immediate emotions, and maintaining family/social roles**. This requires a great deal of **reactive (🐸⚡) and emotional-relational (🐘💞)** mental activity.    
- **Higher tiers (5+: apply, strategize, construct):** these activities require a great deal of **reflective-symbolic (🧘☸️)** mental investment — a high-cost, low-frequency cognitive behavior. Thus, even for high-level talents, the time spent daily on "theorizing" is extremely limited.

In short, childhood development is a **required course**, while adult development is an **elective one**.

### –🪟Fields of Application🎓

Compared to traditional knowledge taxonomies such as **Bloom's Taxonomy**, AQAL covers more ground, integrating dimensions such as **emotion, culture, and behavior** that were left out, forming a more complete map for learning and analysis. This book applies it to the learning and engineering applications of artificial intelligence.

The following are the main fields of application of the AQAL framework:

- 🧍‍♂️ **Personal Growth & Psychology**: Applying the AQAL model allows a more comprehensive understanding of an individual's **psychological growth**, **self-development**, and **personality traits**, covering both inner consciousness and outward behavior.    
- 🤝 **Social & Cultural Analysis**: The model can be used to analyze the evolution of **cultural development**, **social structure**, and **group values**, understanding both the inner meaning and outer systems at the collective level.    
- 🎓 **Education & Learning Design**: Provides **panoramic curricula** and **learning modules** for learners of different ages, promoting **comprehensive development** across cognition, emotion, and morality.    
- 🤖 **AI Education and Engineering**: **This book demonstrates** how to apply the AQAL framework to guide the **dynamic innovation**, **system design**, and **value alignment** (ethical constraint) of AI systems, ensuring that AI development covers both technical (It/Its) and conscious (I/We) dimensions.

## 💪AI Action Subjects and Objects🌌 {#sec-action-orchestration}

"Action Orchestration" concerns **how to orchestrate the subjects and objects of action**, treating **system dynamics** as the practice of a series of **coordinated actions**.

Verb «options» represent numerous possibilities, granting the system a refined **orchestration** capacity for "**embodied agency**" or "**embodied intent**."

To handle the subject-object relationship between humans and machines, and to analyze the **benefits and costs** of "Action Orchestration," we need to distinguish the basic "Action Models" of humans and machines, as described in the table below:

::: {.callout-important #imp-action-models title="💪Distinguishing Human vs. Machine \"Action Models\"" collapse=false open=true}

| Model  | 👶Human Action Model💪<br/>(Body—Mind—Culture)| 🤖Machine Action Model🦾<br/>(Internal Representation/World Model)|
| :---------- | :------------------------------------ | :------------------------------- |
| 🔥💧**Drive Source** | Constrained by three fields: bodily limitation (reaction), mental intention (emotion, symbol), and cultural norms (society). | Primarily derived from algorithm- and data-driven **internal representations** (world models).  |
| 🦾💪**Characteristics**  | Has a "multi-layered nested" nature: action is both individual and collective.| Action is a response to input and an optimization of an objective function, lacking human ethical and emotional context. |
:  **💪Distinguishing Human vs. Machine "Action Models"** {#tbl-action-models}

📌 Distinguishing human vs. machine "action models" helps in applying verb «options» to refine, analyze, and innovatively orchestrate human and machine action.
:::

The salient distinction between the basic "action models" of humans and machines lies in the **constraint**, **drive**, and **agency** exerted by their environmental context.

- 👶 The **human action model** has a "multi-layered nesting" of "**body—mind—culture**"; 
- 🤖 The **machine action model** has an internal-representation response such as a "**world model**";

The "action model" therefore enriches the **contextual understanding and modeling** of verb «options», grounding previously discussed vocabulary, grammar, and so on into the pragmatic dimension of usage — becoming key to understanding and executing the triad of "human—machine—human-machine collaboration" action patterns.

### –🪄Dynamic Model Orchestration

For systemic innovation, "dynamic model orchestration" is the grammar of embedding verb «options» at different levels into **System Dynamics** — designing mechanisms for human-machine collaborative action, granting the **system vitality**.

Key grammar terms include: loops, flows, leverage points, delays, and so on.

> Using a design grammar of "**action—loop—structure**," relevant verb «options» construct or influence the dynamics of human-machine systems

::: {.callout-important #imp-action-loop-structure title="🔗Verb Categories and System Loops" collapse=false open=true .note}

| ✨Action Type| 🔥💧Scope/Function| 🔄Corresponding System Loop | 🦾💪Example Verbs |
| :------------ | :------------ | :------------ | :-------- |
| 🧍**Single-Subject Action**<br/>(triggering R/B loops) | **Direct systemic effect on the environment**, often generating cumulative or corrective effects.  | **Reinforcing loop** (R), cumulative effect; or **balancing loop** (B), self-correction. | "Survive," "Apply," "Achieve" |
| 🤝**Interactive Action**<br/>(information flow and governance nodes) | **Consensus and constraint among subjects and groups**, establishing information flow and normative flow. | Responsible for establishing **information flow** and **normative flow**, increasing collaborative gains.| "Connect," "Collaborate," "Align" |
| 🌀**Emergent Action**<br/>(cross-tier integration and structural change)| **Cross-tier integration and structural change**, reshaping rules and narratives.| Changes **system structure**, reshapes **loop topology**.| "Construct," "Lead," "Transcend" |
:  **🪄Dynamic Model Orchestration** {#tbl-dynamic-orchestration}

📌 Verb «options» construct action **loops** or influence the dynamics of human-machine systems.
:::

Since machines lack the capacity for "autonomous goal-setting," these higher-order actions of constructing or influencing loops must inevitably be human-guided. The resulting design grammar of "**action—loop—structure**" can thus be used to describe and intervene in the dynamics of human-machine systems.

Concrete higher-level verb «options» such as "**contextualize**," "**align**," "**construct**," must be designed and supervised by humans at the levels of "**objective function, rule set, information visibility**," ensuring that each decision and execution node within the loop produces system dynamics that meet expectations.

### –🧭Autonomous Goal-Setting

Since machines lack the capacity for **autonomous goal-setting**, the higher-order **verb «options»** of the AQAL 8 categories (such as **contextualize/systematize**, **align/strategize/integrate**, **construct/lead**) inevitably require **human guidance and design** within "Action Orchestration."

These higher-order verbs are especially important to the following core AI problematics:

* 🔤⚓ [Symbol Grounding Problem](01-03-Symbol_Grounding_Problem.qmd): using "contextualize," "embody," and "correspond" to strengthen the mapping between symbol and world and perceptual feedback.
* 🖼️⏱️ [Frame Problem](01-04-Frame_Problem.qmd): using "delimit," "focus," and "filter" to set boundaries and allocate attention, managing delay and error propagation.
* 👁️⯊ [Gestalt Psychology](01-05-Gestalt_Psychology.qmd): using "fill in," "integrate," and "reconstruct" to stabilize representation amid information gaps, avoiding bias reinforcement.
* 🎯🛡️ [Alignment & Control Problem](01-06-Alignment_Control_Problem.qmd): using "align," "regulate," and "constrain" to maintain **balancing loops** and controllability, preventing reward hacking.
*  🗫🎲 [Language Games](01-07-Language_Games.qmd): using "negotiate," "interpret," and "co-construct" to regulate the **interactive loop** of multi-subject interaction and meaning generation.

###  –⚙️Pipelines and Leverage Points

This book uses "coopetition games" and "framing" as frameworks, treating action as a **strategic intervention** into loops and structures: applying the right verb «options» at the right leverage points to guide the system dynamics toward sustainable equilibrium and innovation.

Among these, the **system pipeline** of "**Action Orchestration**" typically comprises six stage-verb «options» (see 🪜[Cognitive Capacity](appendix-cognitive_capacity.qmd) for details):

- 👁️ **Sense** or 🛰**Sensing**: "detecting" and "collecting" relevant information about the self and the environment — an important basis for world-mapping and perceptual feedback. 
- 🧠 **Interpret** or 🪟**Frame**: "analyzing" and "contextualizing" raw data, converting it into a **usable knowledge stock**.  
- 🗺️ **Plan**: "strategizing," "aligning," "integrating," used to **configure structure and resources** and formulate action plans. 
- 🔨 **Act**: "applying," "collaborating," "achieving," **triggering** reinforcing (R) or balancing (B) loops. 
- ✅ **Evaluate**: "monitoring," "calibrating," used to **regulate** loop gain and monitor outcomes. 
- 🔄 **Adapt**: "reconstructing," "leading," "transcending" — **updating** goals and rules at **leverage points**.

The corresponding **higher-order verbs** at the system leverage points of "**Action Orchestration**" are as follows (from weak to strong):

- ⚙️ **Parameter Adjustment**: Calibrate, Fine-tune, Adjust, Configure 
- 📈 **Feedback Gain**: Reinforce, Amplify, Accelerate, Boost, Facilitate 
- 📉 **Feedback Correction**: Suppress, Counteract, Decelerate, Correct, Buffer 
- 🔀 **Information Flow**: Disclose, Share, Track, Synchronize, Channel 
- 📜 **Rules & Incentives**: Design, Constrain, Redefine, Regulate, Incentivize 
- 🎯 **Goals & Narrative**: Align, Rewrite, Lead, Shape, Initiate

In short, the six-stage pipeline of **Action Orchestration**, paired with the higher-order verbs at their corresponding **leverage points**, provides a **fine-grained operational grammar** for the dynamic behavior of AI systems, ensuring that its evolution can be strategically guided and designed.

### –🎭AI Future Dynamics

The combination of **Action Orchestration** and system dynamics connects the core problems of AI to a series of hypotheses about the overall "future of AI."

Here, verb «options» are extended into a hypothesis-vocabulary of "**action and dynamics**" — "align," "share," "monopolize," "fragment," "universalize" — constituting multiple narratives of future AI **system dynamics**:

::: {.callout-note #nte-world-model-llm-future title="🎭AI Future \"Action Orchestration\" System Dynamics" collapse=false open=true .note}

The "Action Orchestration" system dynamics of each "AI Future" hypothesis:

- 💥 **[AI Alignment Collapse Hypothesis](appendix-glossary.qmd#ai-alignment-collapse)**: If the dynamics of AI's orchestrated action ultimately fail to "align" with human values, the system may enter **negative-feedback imbalance**, leading to collapse; or, under new norms, form a **new equilibrium order**.
- 🌐 **[AI Commons Hypothesis](appendix-glossary.qmd#ai-commons-hypothesis)**: If the dynamics of AI's orchestrated action encourage universal "sharing," the system may fall into a **tragedy of the commons** (overuse, resource depletion); "governance," "negotiation," and "allocation" must therefore be designed to establish a **positive-feedback collaboration mechanism**.
- 👑 **[AI Empire Hypothesis](appendix-glossary.qmd#ai-empire-hypothesis)**: If AI's action is "monopolized" by a small number of power centers, the system will exhibit a **reinforcing loop**, with a small number of actors continually accumulating resources and control, leading to **power centralization** and asymmetric dynamics.
- ⚔️ **[AI Tribalization/Fragmentation Hypothesis](appendix-glossary.qmd#ai-tribalization-fragmentation)**: If different groups each define AI's action differently, the system develops **fragmentation loops**, forming subsystems lacking mutual "alignment" and "collaboration," leading to **fragmented dynamics**.
- 🚰 **[AI Utilities Hypothesis](appendix-glossary.qmd#ai-utilities-hypothesis)**: If AI becomes a "universalized" everyday infrastructure, it will tend toward a **stabilizing loop**, forming a "high-dependency" supply akin to water or electricity — but this may also reduce resilience through over-reliance.
::: 

Thus, it can be said that these verb «options» can both examine AI systems' interaction with the world, and foresee the dynamics of future intelligent society. In this light, each hypothesis can be viewed as a **system-dynamics model**:

- ⚖"Align" ＝ the maintenance or failure of **balancing feedback** 
- 🤝"Share" ＝ the design of **collaborative governance** 
- 👑"Monopolize" ＝ the centralization of a **reinforcing loop** 
- ⚔️"Fragment" ＝ the multiple equilibria of a **fragmentation loop** 
- 🚰"Universalize" ＝ the infrastructuring of a **stabilizing loop**

### –⮔AI Future Causality

The discussion in the previous section can further generate a **Causal Loop Diagram**, intuitively showing how verb «options» drive different future paths, where:

- Core **verb «options»** are the "leverage words" driving the causal loop. 
- **System Dynamics A** and **System Dynamics B** correspond to different loop trajectories (vicious vs. virtuous, imbalanced vs. equilibrium).

As [shown below](#tip-world-model-llm-future-cld)[@tbl-world-model-llm-future-cld], each AI-future hypothesis can be explained via a causal loop, and each generates at least two possible scenarios.

::: {.callout-tip #tip-world-model-llm-future-cld title="⮔ AI Hypothesis Causal Loops" collapse=false open=false }

| Hypothesis | Core Verb «options» | 🌞System Dynamics Scenario A | 🌬System Dynamics Scenario B|
| ------------ | ----------- | ---------------- | ---------------- |
| 💥 AI Alignment Collapse Hypothesis | Align/Deviate/Correct | Negative feedback imbalance → deviation accumulation → collapse| Balancing feedback → effective correction → new order forms  |
| 🌐 AI Commons Hypothesis  | Share/Govern/Allocate | Over-sharing → tragedy of the commons → resource depletion | Collaborative governance → positive-feedback collaboration → sustainable sharing |
| 👑 AI Empire Hypothesis| Monopolize/Centralize/Control | Reinforcing loop → power centralization| Asymmetric dynamics → declining empire-system resilience  |
| ⚔️ AI Tribalization/Fragmentation Hypothesis | Fragment/Oppose/Negotiate | Fragmentation loop → multiple local equilibria | Negotiated alignment → system integration  |
| 🚰 AI Utilities Hypothesis | Universalize/Depend/Stabilize | Universalize → stabilizing loop → infrastructuring  | Over-dependence → increased fragility → declining resilience  |
: ⮔ AI Future Hypotheses' Causal Loops {#tbl-world-model-llm-future-cld}

The futures of AI can be dynamically described through verbs and causal loops, demonstrating that verbs «options» combined with systems analysis can capture the outcomes of systemic-dynamic change — offering insight for ❝orchestrated❞ collaboration.

## 🪜❝Orchestrated❞ Collaboration🎭

Looking back over this appendix collection, we started from the concentric-circle system of verb «options», progressively unfolding "the subjects and objects of action" and "dynamic model orchestration." This path parallels the progressive ❝training❞ of the mind in 🧠*Brain*, but here the emphasis is: **how to orchestrate collaborative action and innovate within system dynamics**.

**1️⃣ The Concentric-Circle System of System Dynamics**

- 🔹 **Core Tier (single-subject action)**: emphasizes verbs such as "survive," "apply," "achieve," corresponding to the direct effect of an individual within the system, forming the most basic **reinforcing** and **balancing loops**.
- 🔸 **Middle Tier (interactive action)**: emphasizes verbs such as "connect," "collaborate," "align," corresponding to information flow and normative flow among groups, forming a **collaborative governance loop** that avoids imbalance and conflict.
- 🔺 **Outer Tier (emergent action)**: emphasizes verbs such as "construct," "lead," "transcend," corresponding to structural change across groups and tiers, triggering an **emergent innovation loop** that reshapes the overall configuration.

**2️⃣ The Progressive Levers of Systemic Innovation**

- ⚙️ **Parameter Adjustment**: "iterate," "optimize," etc., corresponding to short-term correction.
- 📈 **Feedback Gain**: "reinforce," "suppress," etc., adjusting loop gain and delay.
- 🔀 **Information Flow Design**: "disclose," "visualize," etc., increasing visibility and systemic learning capacity.
- 📜 **Rules & Incentives**: "design," "constrain," "delimit," etc., reconstructing norms and incentive structures.
- 🎯 **Goals & Narrative**: "align," "reach consensus," "lead," etc., redefining goals and direction.
- 🔄 **Change Triggers**: "guide," "accelerate," etc., triggering systemic or organizational change.

**3️⃣ The Future Configuration of Collaboration**

- 👶 **Human Collaboration**: action orchestration based on "culture," "ethics," "emotion."
- 🤖 **Machine Collaboration**: action orchestration through data and rules, based on "algorithm," "model," "optimization."
- 🤝 **Human-Machine Collaboration**: based on "co-construction," "negotiation," "alignment," using the grammar of verb «options» to organize the "intent," even "will," of human society's individuals and groups — combining human values with machine efficiency to form the **system dynamics** of a new socio-technical system.

**4️⃣ Benefits, Costs, and Innovation**

- 🌟 **Benefits**: progressive orchestrated collaboration allows human-machine systems to display adaptability and innovative capacity in complex environments.
- ⚡ **Costs**: without adequate alignment and governance, the system may fall into loops of monopoly, fragmentation, or imbalance.
- 🚀 **Innovation**: true systemic innovation comes from applying the appropriate verb «options» at leverage points, turning "Action Orchestration" into "configuration innovation."

**5️⃣ Dynamic Models of AI-Future Hypotheses**

- 💥 **AI Alignment Collapse Hypothesis**: if "alignment" fails, the system enters negative-feedback imbalance, leading to collapse; if correction succeeds, a new order forms.
- 🌐 **AI Commons Hypothesis**: if "sharing" is excessive, it may fall into a tragedy of the commons; if governed well, it forms a sustainable collaborative mechanism.
- 👑 **AI Empire Hypothesis**: if "monopolized" by a small number of power centers, a reinforcing loop and power centralization emerge, weakening system resilience.
- ⚔️ **AI Tribalization/Fragmentation Hypothesis**: if "fragmentation" continues, the system will fragment; if negotiated alignment is achieved, it may integrate into a larger configuration.
- 🚰 **AI Utilities Hypothesis**: if AI becomes universalized infrastructure, the system tends toward stability; but over-dependence may reduce resilience.

**6️⃣ From «Options» to «Choice»**

The verb «options» listed in this appendix — the 10 verb categories, Bloom's 6 categories, the AQAL 8/9 categories — all remain at the stage of **divergence**: laying out the range of possible actions. Truly **converging** them into an executable «choice» requires pairing them with concrete noun «options» (context, goal, constraint), and going through a systematic convergence process. This is exactly what 🔖Appendix 🪜*[Cognitive Capacity](appendix-cognitive_capacity.qmd#sec-cognitive-capacity-scaffolding)*'s "double-diamond model" is meant to do: placing this chapter's verb «options» together with 🔖Appendix 🧠*[Brain](appendix-brain.qmd)*'s noun «options» into a single scaffold, converging them into a «choice».

***

✨ In sum, the verb «options» of this chapter, “💪Action” , echo the noun «options» of the next chapter, 🧠*[Brain](appendix-brain.qmd)*: the former emphasizes the **systemic orchestration of action**, the latter emphasizes the **progressive training of the mind**.

Only through "unity of knowledge and action" can humans and AI, within the system dynamics of the future, not merely avoid imbalance, but co-create a new configuration for civilization.
